Roundhouse Works

An affordable co-working space

Roundhouse Works is a career development programme and community for 18-30-year-old freelancers and early-stage entrepreneurs.

Learn more

What's included

  • Desk in an open plan workspace
  • Fast and reliable WiFi
  • Social events to build your network
  • Free coffee, tea and refreshments
  • Dedicated on-site support team
